description_en: Updates device-related information, such as extending the device authorization validity period, updating custom business identifiers, and updating device IDs. This operation is applicable to scenarios such as device validity period renewal
description_zh: 比如设备授权有效期延长、更新业务方自定义的业务标识和设备ID等。适用于设备有效期续期等场景
name: ModifyDeviceInfo

parameters.help_en: The unique ID generated by the ID Verification server for the device of the requester. This ID is generated only after the device is successfully activated. You can obtain this ID by calling the getLicenseExtraInfo function in the offline facial recognition SDK
parameters.help_zh: 实人认证服务端为接入方设备生成的唯一ID，只有在设备成功激活后才会生成，该ID可通过离线人脸识别SDK里的getLicenseExtraInfo函数获得
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: The updated user device ID. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. This parameter is defined by the requester and can be used to identify a specific device. We recommend that you use the physical device number
parameters.help_zh: 更新的用户设备ID。不超过64字符，由接入方自定义，可用于标识具体设备，建议可以使用设备物理编号
parameters.name: user_device_id

parameters.help_en: The updated business type. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. This parameter is defined by the requester and can be used to add remarks for specific business scenarios, such as different facial recognition usage scenarios or customer identifiers for pending deliveries
parameters.help_zh: 更新的业务类型。不超过64字符。由接入方自定义，可用于对具体业务进行备注，例如可以取接入方不同的人脸使用场景，或者待交付的客户标识等
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: The period by which to extend the device expiration time. Unit: years. Valid values: 1 to 100. A value of 100 indicates permanent use. One year is calculated as 365 days
parameters.help_zh: 延长设备到期的时间。单位：年，范围为[1,100]，取值100表示永久使用。一年按365天计算
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the current device. An error is returned if the expiration date is incorrect (differs from the expiration time recorded on the ID Verification server by more than one week).
You can query the expiration time by calling the DescribeDeviceInfo operation. An error is returned if the expiration date is incorrect. This validation ensures that the requester does not accidentally reactivate a device due to misoperations, which would unnecessarily consume authorization quotas
parameters.help_zh:
当前设备的失效时间。失效日期不正确（和实人认证服务端记录的失效时间相差超过一周），则报错。
该失效时间可以通过DescribeDeviceInfo接口查询获得，失效日期不正确则报错，这个校验是为了确保业务方不因为一些误操作导致重复激活一台设备，误消耗授权
parameters.name: expired_day

BeginDay.description_en: If the Duration request parameter is not empty, this field indicates the authorization start time after the device validity period is extended. One year in Duration is calculated as 365 days. Example: 20180101
BeginDay.description_zh: 若请求参数中Duration不为空，则该字段表示延长设备有效期后，授权开始时间。Duration的1年按365天计算。示例：20180101

BizType.description_en: The value corresponds to the BizType in the request parameters

DeviceId.description_en: The value corresponds to the DeviceId in the request parameters

ExpiredDay.description_en: If the Duration request parameter is not empty, this field indicates the authorization expiration time after the device validity period is extended. One year in Duration is calculated as 365 days. Example: 20180101
ExpiredDay.description_zh: 若请求参数中Duration不为空，则该字段表示延长设备有效期后，授权到期时间。Duration的1年按365天计算。示例：20180101

UserDeviceId.description_en: The value corresponds to the UserDeviceId in the request parameters
